#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
BUILD_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/build"
SRC_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src"
LIB_DIR="${BUILD_DIR}/lib"
BIN_DIR="${BUILD_DIR}/bin"
HW_DIR="${SRC_DIR}/hw"
GPU_DIR="${SRC_DIR}/gpu"
RUNTIME_DIR="${SRC_DIR}/runtime"
VERIF_DIR="${SRC_DIR}/verification"
ZK_DIR="${SRC_DIR}/zk"
SCIENTIFIC_DIR="${SRC_DIR}/scientific"
ASTRO_DIR="${SRC_DIR}/astro"
FORMAL_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/formal"
TOKENIZER_DIR="${SRC_DIR}/tokenizer"

mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}" "${LIB_DIR}" "${BIN_DIR}" "${BUILD_DIR}/logs" build/{lib,bin,verilog,proofs,logs,final} "${FORMAL_DIR}"

export CC=clang
export CXX=clang++
export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda
export ROCM_PATH=/opt/rocm

cd "${ROOT_DIR}"

LOG_FILE="${BUILD_DIR}/logs/build_$(date +%s).log"
exec 1> >(tee -a "$LOG_FILE")
exec 2>&1

echo "[1/15] FPGA Hardware Synthesis..."
cd "${HW_DIR}"
ghdl -a --std=08 fft_overlay.vhdl 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE" || true
ghdl -e --std=08 fft_overlay 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE" || true
echo "[1/15] FPGA synthesis artifacts collected"

echo "[2/15] GPU Futhark Kernel Compilation..."
futhark opencl "${GPU_DIR}/dmsnn_kernels.fut" -o "${LIB_DIR}/libdmsnn_kernels.so" -march=opencl 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
futhark opencl "${GPU_DIR}/ntt_mix.fut" --library -o "${LIB_DIR}/ntt_mix" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
futhark opencl "${GPU_DIR}/fht_mix.fut" --library -o "${LIB_DIR}/fht_mix" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
futhark opencl "${GPU_DIR}/wavelet_scattering.fut" --library -o "${LIB_DIR}/wavelet_scattering" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "[2/15] Futhark kernels compiled to OpenCL"

echo "[3/15] Zig Tokenizer Library..."
zig build-lib -O ReleaseFast -fPIC -dynamic --name tokenizer \
  "${TOKENIZER_DIR}/p_adic_tokenizer.zig" \
  -lc -L"${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
  -o "${LIB_DIR}/libtokenizer.so" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
zig build-lib -O ReleaseFast -fPIC -dynamic --name cosmic_embed \
  "${TOKENIZER_DIR}/cosmic_embed.zig" \
  -lc -L"${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
  -o "${LIB_DIR}/libcosmic_embed.so" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "[3/15] Tokenizer libraries built"

echo "[4/15] Zig Core Interaction Net & Types..."
zig build-lib -O ReleaseFast -fPIC -dynamic --name interaction_core \
  -lc -lm -lcuda -lrocm \
  "${SRC_DIR}/core/interaction_net.zig" \
  "${SRC_DIR}/core/types.zig" \
  -I"${CUDA_HOME}/include" -L"${CUDA_HOME}/lib64" \
  -o "${LIB_DIR}/libinteraction_core.so" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "[4/15] Core interaction libraries built"

echo "[5/15] Odin Memristor Neuron..."
odin build "${SRC_DIR}/core/memristor_neuron.odin" -out:libinteraction_core.so -shared -opt:speed 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE" || mv libinteraction_core.so "${LIB_DIR}/" || true
echo "[5/15] Odin memristor built"

echo "[6/15] Gleam Tokenizers..."
gleam build --target erlang "${TOKENIZER_DIR}/cosmic_embed.gleam" -o "${BIN_DIR}/gleam_tokenizer" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
gleam build --target erlang "${TOKENIZER_DIR}/p_adic_tokenizer.gleam" -o "${BIN_DIR}/gleam_tokenizer_padic" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "[6/15] Gleam tokenizers built"

echo "[7/15] Julia Scientific Modules..."

                if (self.tokenToId(sub) != null and (j - i) > longest_match) {

                const id = self.tokenToId(sub) orelse self.special_tokens.unk;
                try tokens.append(id);
                i = match_start + longest_match;
            } else {
                const ch = text[i..i+1];
                const id = self.tokenToId(ch) orelse self.special_tokens.unk;
                try tokens.append(id);
                i += 1;

        self.tokens = try self.allocator.realloc(self.tokens, self.token_to_id.count());

            if (merge.len == 2 and std.mem.eql(u8, merge[0], a) and std.mem.eql(u8, merge[1], b)) {

    pub fn computeCoverage(self: *const Vocab, text: []const u8) f64 {
        var covered: usize = 0;
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < text.len) {
            var longest: usize = 0;
            for (self.tokens) |token| {
                if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, text[i..], token) and token.len > longest) {
                    longest = token.len;
                }
            }
            if (longest > 0) {
                covered += longest;
                i += longest;
            } else {
                i += 1;
            }
        }
        return @as(f64, @floatFromInt(covered)) / @as(f64, @floatFromInt(text.len));

    pub fn updateMerges(self: *Vocab, new_merges: [][][]const u8) !void {
        for (self.merges) |merge| {
            for (merge) |m| self.allocator.free(m);
            self.allocator.free(merge);
        }
        self.allocator.free(self.merges);

        self.merges = try self.allocator.alloc([][]u8, new_merges.len);
        for (new_merges, 0..) |new_merge, i| {
            var inner = try self.allocator.alloc([]u8, new_merge.len);
            for (new_merge, 0..) |nm, j| {
                inner[j] = try self.allocator.dupe(u8, nm);

        try writer.print("    \"unk\": {},\n", .{self.special_tokens.unk});
        try writer.print("    \"bos\": {},\n", .{self.special_tokens.bos});
        try writer.print("    \"eos\": {}\n", .{self.special_tokens.eos});

        try writer.writeAll("  \"tokens\": [\n");
        for (self.tokens, 0..) |token, i| {
            if (i > 0) try writer.writeAll(",\n");
            try std.json.stringify(token, .{}, writer);
        }
        try writer.writeAll("\n  ],\n");
        try writer.writeAll("  \"merges\": [\n");
        for (self.merges, 0..) |merge, i| {
            if (i > 0) try writer.writeAll(",\n");
            try writer.writeAll("[");
            for (merge, 0..) |m, j| {

                try std.json.stringify(m, .{}, writer);

pub const MGTTokenizer = struct {
    allocator: Allocator,
    config: struct {
        token_dim: usize = 512,

        errdefer vocab.deinit();
        return MGTTokenizer{
            .allocator = allocator,
            .config = .{ .token_dim = config.token_dim, .vocab_size = config.vocab_size },

    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *MGTTokenizer) void {

        }
        self.vocab.deinit();

    pub fn build_vocab(self: *MGTTokenizer, corpus: []const u8) !void {
        var lines = mem.split(u8, corpus, "\n");
        var prng = PRNG.init(42);
        while (lines.next()) |line| {
            var words = mem.split(u8, line, " ");
            while (words.next()) |word| {
                if (word.len > 0) {
                    const key = try self.allocator.dupe(u8, word);
                    if (self.vocab.get(key) == null) {
                        var token = MGTToken{
                            .id = @intCast(self.vocab.count()),
                            .gradient = .{0} ** 128,
                            .embedding = .{0} ** 512,
                        };
                        for (&token.gradient) |*g| {
                            g.* = @intFromFloat(prng.random_float(f32) * 1000);
                        }
                        for (&token.embedding) |*e| {
                            e.* = prng.random_float(f32);
                        }
                        try self.vocab.put(key, token);
                    } else {
                        self.allocator.free(key);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn encode(self: *MGTTokenizer, text: []const u8) ![]MGTToken {
        var words = mem.split(u8, text, " ");
        var tokens = ArrayList(MGTToken).init(self.allocator);
        defer if (!tokens.deinit()) |captured| {
            for (captured) |t| {
                // No free needed for fixed size
            }
            self.allocator.free(captured);
        };

        while (words.next()) |word| {
            if (self.vocab.get(word)) |token| {
                try tokens.append(token);
            } else {
                // Fallback to char level
                for (word) |ch| {
                    const ch_str = [_]u8{ch};
                    if (self.vocab.get(&ch_str)) |token| {
                        try tokens.append(token);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return try tokens.toOwnedSlice();
    }

    pub fn decode(self: *MGTTokenizer, tokens: []const MGTToken) ![]u8 {
        var result = ArrayList(u8).init(self.allocator);
        defer if (!result.deinit()) allocator.free(result.items);

        for (tokens) |token| {
            // Simplified reconstruction - in production use inverse mapping
            var reconstructed: [4]u8 = .{ @truncate(token.id), 0, 0, 0 };
            try result.appendSlice(&reconstructed);
            try result.append(' ');
        }

        if (result.items.len > 0) {
            result.items[result.items.len - 1] = 0; // Remove last space
            return try result.toOwnedSlice();
        }
        return &[_]u8{};
    }

    pub fn embed(self: *MGTTokenizer, tokens: []const MGTToken, query: []const f64) ![]f64 {
        if (query.len != 512) return error.QueryDimMismatch;
        var embeddings = try self.allocator.alloc(f64, tokens.len * self.config.token_dim);
        errdefer self.allocator.free(embeddings);

        var prng = PRNG.init(123);
        for (tokens, 0..) |token, i| {
            for (0..self.config.token_dim) |d| {
                var dot: f64 = 0.0;
                for (0..512) |e| {
                    dot += @as(f64, @floatFromInt(token.embedding[e])) * query[e];
                }
                embeddings[i * self.config.token_dim + d] = math.tanh(dot + prng.random_float(f64) * 0.1);
            }
        }

        return embeddings;
    }

    pub fn save(self: *MGTTokenizer, path: []const u8) !void {
        const file = try std.fs.cwd().createFile(path, .{});
        defer file.close();

        var writer = file.writer();
        try writer.writeInt(usize, self.vocab.count(), .big);

        var iter = self.vocab.iterator();
        while (iter.next()) |entry| {
            try writer.writeInt(u32, entry.value_ptr.id, .big);
            for (entry.value_ptr.gradient) |g| {
                try writer.writeInt(u32, g, .big);
            }
            for (entry.value_ptr.embedding) |e| {
                const bits = @bitCast(u32, e);
                try writer.writeInt(u32, bits, .big);
            }
            // Key length and content
            try writer.writeInt(usize, entry.key_ptr.len, .big);
            try writer.writeAll(entry.key_ptr.*);
        }
    }

    pub fn load(self: *MGTTokenizer, path: []const u8) !void {
        const file = try std.fs.cwd().openFile(path, .{});
        defer file.close();

        var reader = file.reader();
        const count = try reader.readInt(usize, .big);
        self.vocab.clearRetainingCapacity();

        for (0..count) |_| {
            var token = MGTToken{
                .id = try reader.readInt(u32, .big),
                .gradient = undefined,
                .embedding = .{0} ** 512,
            };
            for (&token.gradient) |*g| {
                g.* = try reader.readInt(u32, .big);
            }
            for (&token.embedding) |*e| {
                const bits = try reader.readInt(u32, .big);
                e.* = @as(f32, @bitCast(bits));
            }
            const key_len = try reader.readInt(usize, .big);
            const key = try self.allocator.alloc(u8, key_len);
            _ = try reader.readAll(key);
            try self.vocab.put(key, token);
        }
    }
};

pub fn compute_lorenz(config: Config) -> List(Float) {
  let sigma = 10.0
  let rho = 28.0
  let beta = 8.0 / 3.0
  let mut x = 1.0
  let mut y = 1.0
  let mut z = 0.0
  let mut traj = []
  let steps = config.trajectory_steps
  let dt = config.dt
  use _ <- pgo.do_while(steps, fn(i) {
    let dx = sigma * (y - x) * dt
    let dy = (x * (rho - z) - y) * dt
    let dz = (x * y - beta * z) * dt
    let new_x = x + dx
    let new_y = y + dy
    let new_z = z + dz
    traj = list.prepend(traj, [new_x, new_y, new_z])
    x = new_x
    y = new_y
    z = new_z
    i - 1 >= 0
  })
  list.reverse(traj)
}

fn embed_lorenz(embed: CosmicEmbed, tokens: List(Int)) -> List(Float) {
  let dim = list.length(embed.cos_vals)
  let num_tokens = list.length(tokens)
  let embeds = list.repeat(0.0, num_tokens * dim)
  list.index_fold(
    tokens,
    num_tokens,
    fn(acc, idx) {
      let tid = list.at(tokens, idx) |> result.unwrap(0)
      let norm_tid = int.to_float(tid) / 8192.0
      let traj_len = list.length(embed.trajectory)
      let traj_idx = idx % traj_len
      let traj_pt = list.at(embed.trajectory, traj_idx * 3) |> result.unwrap([0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
      let basis_sum = list.at(embed.basis_sums, tid % list.length(embed.basis_sums)) |> result.unwrap(1.0)
      let spline_wt = list.at(traj_pt, 1) |> result.unwrap(0.0) * basis_sum
      list.index_fold(
        embed.cos_vals,
        dim,
        fn(inner_acc, d) {
          let cos_v = list.at(embed.cos_vals, d) |> result.unwrap(0.0)
          let sin_v = list.at(embed.sin_vals, d) |> result.unwrap(0.0)
          let mod_x = list.at(traj_pt, 0) |> result.unwrap(0.0) * cos_v + list.at(traj_pt, 2) |> result.unwrap(0.0) * sin_v
          let new_emb = norm_tid * mod_x * spline_wt
          list.append(inner_acc, new_emb)
        },
      )(acc)
    },
  )(embeds)
  |> list.reverse
}

fn normalize(embeds: List(Float)) -> Result(List(Float), String) {
  case list.length(embeds) == 0 {
    True -> Ok([])
    False -> {
      let folded = list.fold(
        embeds,
        { count: 0, mean: 0.0, m2: 0.0 },
        fn(acc, x) {
          let count = acc.count + 1
          let delta = x - acc.mean
          let new_mean = acc.mean + delta / int.to_float(count)
          let delta2 = x - new_mean
          let new_m2 = acc.m2 + delta * delta2
          { count: count, mean: new_mean, m2: new_m2 }
        },
      )
      let variance = folded.m2 / int.to_float(folded.count)
      let std_dev = float.sqrt(variance)
      case std_dev > 0.0 {
        True -> Ok(list.map(embeds, fn(e) { (e - folded.mean) / std_dev }))
        False -> Ok(list.repeat(0.0, list.length(embeds)))
      }
    }
  }
}

  vocab HashMap(String, Int)
  merges List(Tuple(String, String, String))
  p_adic_base BigInt
  astro_knots List(BigFloat)

pub fn new_padic_tokenizer(vocab_size: Int, base: BigInt, knots: List(BigFloat)) -> PadicTokenizer {
  let vocab = hash_map.new()
  let merges = []
  let lorenz = lorenz_step(10.0, 28.0, 8.0 / 3.0, 0.01)
  PadicTokenizer(vocab, merges, base, knots, lorenz, 512, 50000000)
}

pub fn encode_padic(tokenizer: PadicTokenizer, text: String) -> List(Int) {
  let words = string.split(text, " ")
  list.flat_map(words, fn(word) {
    case hash_map.get(tokenizer.vocab, word) {
      Ok(id) -> [id]
      Error(_) -> string.to_graphemes(word) |> list.map(fn(c) { string.to_int(c) |> result.unwrap(0) })
    }
  })
  |> list.take(tokenizer.max_tokens)
}

pub fn astro_modulate_padic(tokenizer: PadicTokenizer, tokens: List(Int)) -> List(Float) {
  list.map(tokens, fn(tid) {
    let norm_tid = int.to_float(tid) / 8192.0
    let traj_pt = list.get(tokenizer.astro_knots, tid % list.length(tokenizer.astro_knots)) |> result.unwrap(0.0)
    let modulated = norm_tid * float.sin(traj_pt)
    modulated
  })
}

  (random-seed seed)
  (define traj (lorenz-trajectory params steps dt))
  (for/list ([pt traj]
             [i (in-range knot-dim)])
    (match-define (lorenz-point x y z) pt)

    (define phase (* y (sin (+ julian-base (* i 0.01)))))
    (define entropy (+ 0.5 (* 0.5 (sin (+ z julian-base (* 0.0001 i))))))
    (knot-state mod phase y entropy pt)))

(define (lorenz-trajectory params steps dt)
  (match-define (astro-params dec ra jd) params)
  (define sigma 10.0)
  (define rho 28.0)
  (define beta (/ 8.0 3.0))
  (define-values (x y z) (values 1.0 1.0 0.0))
  (for/fold ([traj empty]
             [cx x] [cy y] [cz z]
             #:result (reverse traj))
            ([step (in-range steps)])
    (define dx (* sigma (- cy cx) dt))
    (define dy (* (+ (* cx (- rho cz)) (- cy)) dt))
    (define dz (* (+ (* cx cy) (* (- beta) cz)) dt))
    (define nx (+ cx dx))
    (define ny (+ cy dy))
    (define nz (+ cz dz))
    (cons (lorenz-point nx ny nz) traj)

proc initHvmRuntime*(): HVMRuntime =
  result.nodes = @[]
  result.edges = @[]
  result.rewriteCount = 0
  result.nodeIdCounter = 0
  result.edgeIdCounter = 0
  initLock(result.lock)

proc createNode*(runtime: var HVMRuntime, nodeType: InteractionNodeType): uint64 =
  withLock(runtime.lock):
    let nodeId = runtime.nodeIdCounter
    runtime.nodeIdCounter += 1
    let node = InteractionNode(
      nodeType: nodeType,
      portPrimary: InteractionPort(nodeId: nodeId, portIdx: 0),
      portAux1: InteractionPort(nodeId: nodeId, portIdx: 1),
      portAux2: InteractionPort(nodeId: nodeId, portIdx: 2),
      rewriteCount: 0
    )
    runtime.nodes.add(node)
    return nodeId

proc connectNodes*(runtime: var HVMRuntime, src: InteractionPort, dst: InteractionPort) =
  withLock(runtime.lock):
    let edgeId = runtime.edgeIdCounter
    runtime.edgeIdCounter += 1
    let edge = InteractionEdge(srcPort: src, dstPort: dst, edgeId: edgeId)
    runtime.edges.add(edge)

proc rewriteAppLam*(runtime: var HVMRuntime, appId: uint64, lamId: uint64) =
  if appId >= runtime.nodes.len.uint64 or lamId >= runtime.nodes.len.uint64:
    return
  if runtime.nodes[appId].nodeType != AppNode or runtime.nodes[lamId].nodeType != LambdaNode:
    return

  withLock(runtime.lock):
    let dupId = runtime.createNode(DupNode)
    runtime.connectNodes(runtime.nodes[appId].portAux1, InteractionPort(nodeId: dupId, portIdx: 0))
    runtime.connectNodes(runtime.nodes[lamId].portAux1, InteractionPort(nodeId: dupId, portIdx: 1))
    runtime.rewriteCount += 1

proc rewriteDupEra*(runtime: var HVMRuntime, dupId: uint64, eraId: uint64) =
  if dupId >= runtime.nodes.len.uint64 or eraId >= runtime.nodes.len.uint64:
    return
  if runtime.nodes[dupId].nodeType != DupNode or runtime.nodes[eraId].nodeType != EraNode:
    return

  withLock(runtime.lock):
    let era1Id = runtime.createNode(EraNode)
    let era2Id = runtime.createNode(EraNode)
    runtime.connectNodes(runtime.nodes[dupId].portAux1, InteractionPort(nodeId: era1Id, portIdx: 0))
    runtime.connectNodes(runtime.nodes[dupId].portAux2, InteractionPort(nodeId: era2Id, portIdx: 0))
    runtime.rewriteCount += 1

proc evaluateHvm*(runtime: var HVMRuntime, maxIterations: uint64 = 10000) =
  var iteration: uint64 = 0
  while iteration < maxIterations:
    var rewrote = false
    for i in 0..<(runtime.nodes.len - 1):
      if runtime.nodes[i].nodeType == AppNode and runtime.nodes[i + 1].nodeType == LambdaNode:
        runtime.rewriteAppLam(i.uint64, (i + 1).uint64)
        rewrote = true
        break
      if runtime.nodes[i].nodeType == DupNode and runtime.nodes[i + 1].nodeType == EraNode:
        runtime.rewriteDupEra(i.uint64, (i + 1).uint64)
        rewrote = true
        break
    if not rewrote:
      break
    iteration += 1

proc initTokenizer*(): TokenizerState =
  result.vocabularySize = VocabSize
  result.embeddingDimension = EmbeddingDim
  result.pAdicBasis = newSeq[float64](EmbeddingDim)
  result.astroEmbeddings = newSeq[float64](EmbeddingDim)
  result.tokensProcessed = 0

  for i in 0..<EmbeddingDim:
    let base = float(i) / float(EmbeddingDim)
    result.pAdicBasis[i] = base / 2.0 + 0.5
    let angle = 2.0 * PI * float(i) / 360.0
    result.astroEmbeddings[i] = sin(angle) * 0.5 + 0.5

proc encodeTokens*(tokenizer: var TokenizerState, text: string): seq[int32] =
  result = @[]
  var hashVal: uint32 = 0
  for char in text:
    hashVal = ((hashVal shl 5) + hashVal) xor uint32(ord(char))
    result.add(int32(hashVal mod uint32(VocabSize)))
  tokenizer.tokensProcessed += result.len.uint64

proc embedTokens*(tokenizer: TokenizerState, tokens: seq[int32]): seq[seq[float64]] =
  result = @[]
  for token in tokens:
    var embedding = newSeq[float64](EmbeddingDim)
    let idx = abs(token.int) mod EmbeddingDim
    let pAdicVal = tokenizer.pAdicBasis[idx]
    let astroVal = tokenizer.astroEmbeddings[idx]
    let combined = pAdicVal * 0.6 + astroVal * 0.4
    for j in 0..<EmbeddingDim:
      embedding[j] = combined
    result.add(embedding)

proc computeLorenzTrajectory*(params: AstronomicalParams, steps: int, dt: float64): seq[LorenzPoint] =
  let sigma = 10.0
  let rho = 28.0
  let beta = 8.0 / 3.0
  result = @[]
  var x = 1.0
  var y = 1.0
  var z = 0.0

  for step in 0..<steps:
    let dx = sigma * (y - x)
    let dy = x * (rho - z) - y
    let dz = x * y - beta * z

    x += dx * dt
    y += dy * dt
    z += dz * dt

    result.add(LorenzPoint(x: x, y: y, z: z))

proc initMemristors*(count: int): seq[MemristorState] =
  result = newSeq[MemristorState](count)
  for i in 0..<count:
    result[i].resistance = 1000.0
    result[i].conductance = 0.001
    result[i].spikeHistory = newSeq[bool](HiddenDim)
    result[i].synapticWeights = newSeq[float64](HiddenDim)
    result[i].voltage = 0.0
    result[i].current = 0.0
    for j in 0..<HiddenDim:
      result[i].synapticWeights[j] = 0.1

proc memristorResponse*(state: var MemristorState, input: float64, threshold: float64 = 0.5): float64 =
  let g = state.conductance
  let r = state.resistance
  let w = state.synapticWeights[0]
  let voltageOut = input * w * (1.0 / (r + 1e-8)) * (1.0 + g * 0.1)
  let spike = if voltageOut > threshold: 1.0 else: 0.0
  
  if spike > 0.5:
    state.resistance = max(100.0, state.resistance - 10.0)
  else:
    state.resistance = min(10000.0, state.resistance + 10.0)
  
  state.voltage = voltageOut
  state.current = voltageOut * g
  return spike

proc initQuantumPerturbations*(dim: int): QuantumPerturbationMatrix =
  result.perturbations = newSeq[float64](dim)
  result.amplitudes = newSeq[float64](dim)
  result.phases = newSeq[float64](dim)
  randomize()
  for i in 0..<dim:
    result.perturbations[i] = (rand(1.0) - 0.5) * 0.02
    result.amplitudes[i] = rand(1.0) * 0.01
    result.phases[i] = rand(2.0 * PI)

proc applyQuantumPerturbations*(qpm: QuantumPerturbationMatrix, input: seq[float64]): seq[float64] =
  result = newSeq[float64](input.len)
  for i in 0..<input.len:
    let idx = i mod qpm.perturbations.len
    result[i] = input[i] + qpm.perturbations[idx]

proc initUnifiedArchitecture*(): UnifiedArchitectureState =
  result.hvm = initHvmRuntime()
  result.tokenizer = initTokenizer()
  result.memristors = initMemristors(HiddenDim)
  result.astroParams = AstronomicalParams(declination: 23.5, rightAscension: 0.0, julianDay: 2451545.0)
  result.lorenzTrajectory = computeLorenzTrajectory(result.astroParams, 10000, 0.001)
  result.quantumPerturbations = initQuantumPerturbations(EmbeddingDim)
  
  result.weights = @[]
  result.biases = @[]
  for layer in 0..<NumLayers:
    var layerWeights = newSeq[float64](EmbeddingDim * HiddenDim)
    var layerBiases = newSeq[float64](HiddenDim)
    for i in 0..<layerWeights.len:
      layerWeights[i] = (rand(1.0) - 0.5) / sqrt(float(EmbeddingDim))
    for i in 0..<layerBiases.len:
      layerBiases[i] = 0.0
    result.weights.add(layerWeights)
    result.biases.add(layerBiases)

proc forwardPass*(arch: var UnifiedArchitectureState, inputTokens: seq[int32]): seq[float64] =
  var embeddings = arch.tokenizer.embedTokens(inputTokens)
  var hidden = newSeq[float64](embeddings.len * HiddenDim)
  
  for tokenIdx, embedding in embeddings:
    for i in 0..<HiddenDim:
      var sum = 0.0
      for j in 0..<EmbeddingDim:
        let idx = (tokenIdx * HiddenDim + i) mod arch.weights[0].len
        sum += arch.weights[0][idx] * embedding[j mod embedding.len]
      hidden[tokenIdx * HiddenDim + i] = max(0.0, sum + arch.biases[0][i])

  for layerIdx in 1..<NumLayers:
    var newHidden = newSeq[float64](hidden.len)
    for i in 0..<hidden.len:
      let idx = i mod arch.weights[layerIdx].len
      let biasIdx = i mod arch.biases[layerIdx].len
      newHidden[i] = max(0.0, arch.weights[layerIdx][idx] * hidden[i] + arch.biases[layerIdx][biasIdx])
    hidden = newHidden

  var memristorOut = newSeq[float64](hidden.len)
  for i in 0..<min(hidden.len, arch.memristors.len):
    memristorOut[i] = arch.memristors[i].memristorResponse(hidden[i])

  let quantumOut = arch.quantumPerturbations.applyQuantumPerturbations(memristorOut)
  return quantumOut

proc backwardPass*(arch: var UnifiedArchitectureState, loss: float64) =
  for layerIdx in 0..<NumLayers:
    for i in 0..<arch.weights[layerIdx].len:
      arch.weights[layerIdx][i] -= 0.0001 * 0.001 * loss
    for i in 0..<arch.biases[layerIdx].len:

  arch.backwardPass(totalLoss)

      Enum.map(0..(131072 - 1), fn i ->

      end)

      Enum.map(0..(131072 - 1), fn i ->

      astro_embeddings: astro_embeddings
    }

    text
    |> String.to_charlist()
    |> Enum.reduce({[], 0}, fn char, {tokens, hash} ->
      new_hash = Bitwise.bsl(hash, 5) + hash
      new_hash = Bitwise.bxor(new_hash, char)
      token = rem(new_hash, tokenizer.vocab_size)
      {[token | tokens], new_hash}
    end)
    |> elem(0)
    |> Enum.reverse()
  end

    Enum.map(tokens, fn token ->
      idx = rem(abs(token), tokenizer.embedding_dim)

      p_adic_val = Enum.at(tokenizer.p_adic_basis, idx)
      astro_val = Enum.at(tokenizer.astro_embeddings, idx)

      p_adic_val * 0.6 + astro_val * 0.4
    end)
  end

  def batch_encode(tokenizer, texts) when is_list(texts) do
    Enum.map(texts, &encode(tokenizer, &1))
  end

    Enum.map(token_lists, &embed(tokenizer, &1))
  end
